g.text: Prior work is organized by output type; contracts differ in editability, and VLM
scores are mostly used for evaluation, not as release gates
Representative systems per output type, what they emit, and the contract each leaves open (§5.1–5.5)

"Rather than claiming the first multi-artifact generator, ResearchStudio-Reel focuses on a native-editable, section-aligned dissemination workspace."
(§5.5) The distinction it draws is native editability plus experience-level convergence, backed by release checks.
